title: How to care for your ceramics
description: A few simple habits that keep stoneware looking new for years.
author: The Starter Store team
html:
This post is stored as JSON with an html field, the format the store builder uses when it migrates posts from an existing site. The HTML is sanitised before it is rendered.

Everyday care

  • Let mugs cool before washing them in cold water.
  • Avoid abrasive scrubbers on glazed surfaces.
  • Dry thoroughly before stacking.
